The honest answer

But how does it taste?

Fair question. Bone broth, sea moss and a volcanic mineral don't sound like dessert.

It's cacao-forward and unsweetened, closer to dark chocolate than a candy-bar shake. Ten seconds in the shaker and it mixes smooth in water, milk or coffee. Blend it with a banana or frozen berries if you like it creamier.

Questions

Zeotein Cacao, answered

What is Zeotein Cacao?

A six-ingredient cacao protein powder: grass-fed beef bone broth protein, grass-fed collagen peptides, organic fermented cacao, organic MCT oil powder, organic sea moss and a naturally occurring volcanic mineral. Each serving has 23g protein, 14g collagen peptides, 140 calories and zero sugar.

What is the volcanic mineral?

A naturally occurring mineral formed from volcanic ash, finely milled. Its full name is listed on the Supplement Facts panel printed on every bag. Questions about any ingredient? Email hello@zeotein.com and a real person will answer.

How do I make it?

One serving is two scoops in 10 to 12 oz of water, milk or coffee. Shake for about ten seconds, or blend it into a smoothie. A banana or frozen berries makes it creamier.

How does the Starter Kit subscription work?

Your first order is $76.99 and includes the bag, the CleanBlend shaker, the Save-A-Scoop and three guides. After that, a refill bag ships at $99.99 every 30 days, 6 weeks or 8 weeks, whichever you pick, until you cancel. Skip, pause, change the date or cancel anytime in your account. Shipping is free in the US on every Starter Kit order.

How does the 30-day guarantee work?

Your first order of a protein blend is covered for 30 days from delivery. Email hello@zeotein.com, we'll send return instructions, and we refund the purchase price of one 30-day supply once the return arrives. Opened bags are fine. Return shipping is on you, and the free items are yours to keep. Full refund policy.

Is it gluten-free and dairy-free?

Yes. Zeotein Cacao is gluten-free, dairy-free and soy-free, with no sweeteners and no whey. The protein comes from beef bone broth and bovine collagen, so it is not vegan. For plant protein, see Zeotein Vegan.

Should I check with my doctor first?

If you're pregnant, nursing, taking medication or managing a medical condition, check with your healthcare provider before starting any supplement, including this one.
